scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sc/date && npm run build --workspace @sc/i18n && npm run build --workspace @sc/excel && npm run build --workspace @sc/ui && npm run build --workspace @sc/runtime && npm run build --workspace @sc/reference-app && npm run build --workspace @sc/starter-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @sc/date && npm run typecheck --workspace @sc/i18n && npm run typecheck --workspace @sc/excel && npm run typecheck --workspace @sc/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @sc/runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @sc/reference-app && npm run typecheck --workspace @sc/starter-app && npm run typecheck --workspace @sc/catalog && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test --config frontend/playwright.config.ts && npm run test:reports
scripts.test:visual: SC_VISUAL=1 SC_VISUAL_UPDATE=0 playwright test --config frontend/playwright.config.ts visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots=none
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run api:check && npm run ui:contracts:check && npm run ui:boundaries:check && npm run visual:manifest:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.api:check-server: python3 scripts/check-openapi.py --snapshot docs/openapi-reference-default.json && python3 scripts/check-openapi.py --jar backend/starter-app/target/sc-starter-app.jar --snapshot docs/openapi-starter-default.json
scripts.api:check-operations-server: python3 scripts/check-openapi.py --profile dev,operations && python3 scripts/check-openapi.py --profile dev,operations --jar backend/starter-app/target/sc-starter-app.jar --snapshot docs/openapi-starter.json
